source: Yahi nahi ek saal ki sazā aur 25 hazaar rupaye jurmāna bhi bhugatna pad sakta hai. Tamil Nadu ki Chief Minister J. Jayalalithaa ne budhwar ko assembly mein bill present kiya. Yeh bill veshti (dhoti) ke saath anya traditional Indian outfits ke liye bhi valid hoga. The Tamil Nadu Entry Into Public Places (Removal of Restriction of Dress) Act 2014 ko guruvaar ko assembly mein pass kiya ja sakta hai. Gauratlab hai ki haal hi mein ek cricket club ne dhoti pehne Madras High Court ke ek judge ko entry dene se inkaar kar diya tha. Is par kaafi controversy hua tha aur sab political parties ne iski ninda ki thi. Iske baad Chief Minister Jayalalithaa ne assembly mein announcement ki thi 'dhoti' ko recognition dene ke liye wo assembly mein bill laayengi. Bill mein kaha gaya hai, "Tamil Nadu ki culture ka hissa veshti (dhoti) ya kisi anya Indian outfit pehne vyakti ko kisi bhi public place mein entry se inkaar nahi kiya ja sakta, bas condition ye hai ki outfit ko modestly pehna gaya ho." source: North Sea mein year 1904-1906 ke beech samundar mein chhodi gayi ek bottle Germany ke Amrum beach par ek woman ko mili hai. Iske andar daale gaye post card mein likha gaya tha ki milne par ise Britain ke Marine Biological Association ko send kar diya jaye. Plymouth mein located is Association ka kehna hai ki yeh bottle ek research ke tahat samundar mein chhodi gayi kareeb 1,000 bottles mein se ek hai. Ek shilling ka inaam George Parker Bidder ne research mein kiya tha bottles ka istemal year 1939-1945 ke beech Marine Biological Association ke president rahe George Parker Bidder ke leadership mein samudri lehron par ek research kiya gaya tha jiske tahat bottles samundar mein chhodi gayi thi. Samapt bottle ke andar jo post card tha usmein likha gaya ki bottle lautane wale ko ek shilling ka inaam diya jayega. Bottle lautane wali Marien Winkleer ko April mein Association ne inaam ka ek shilling bhejvaya tha. Marien Winkleer Britain se kareeb 400 kilometre se zyada door Germany ke ek island par chhuttiyan manane gayi thi jab unhe yeh bottle mili. Association ka kehna hai ki wo yeh jaanne ka intezar kar rahe hain ki bottle mein milne wala duniya ka sabse purana message hone ka record banate hain ya nahi. Filhaal bottle mein milne wale sabse purane message ka record 99 saal 43 din ek purane message ke naam hai jo ki Shetland Islands mein July 2013 mein mila tha. source: Barack Obama ne pichle election ke dauran bhi outsourcing ke khilaf bahut sakht bhashan diye the White House par apna kabza banaye rakhne ki daud ke dauran Obama ne America se Bharat aur Philippines jaise mulkon ki ore naukriyan badhane ko galat bataya tha. Obama ne prachar ke dauran America mein naukriyon ko badhane ke liye outsourcing ko hatottshahit karne ki baat kahi thi. Lekin Bharatiya industry jagat ke pramukh organization CII ke Mahaanideshak Chandrjeet Banerjee ka maanna hai "Zyadaatar jo election ke dauran kaha gaya use rajneetik atishyokti alankar maan sakte hain. Iska koi khaas farak nahi padega." Paraspar labhprad Barack Obama ki pehli prathmikta America ki arthvyavastha ko sudharne ki hogi aur ismein Bharatiya companies bada yogdan de sakti hain. Banerjee ne kaha "Bharatiya companies ne pichle ek saal mein America mein apne nivesh se 20,000 nai naukriyan paida ki hain." Isi tarah se ek doosre vyaparik organization FICCI ke adhyaksh R V Kanoria ne bhi Barack Obama ki jeet par khushi jatate hue kaha hai "Bharatiya mool ke matdataon ne Barack Obama ki jeet mein ek badi bhumika ada ki hai. Asha hai ki in matdataon ke saath Bharat aur America apne vyaparik rishton ko aur mazboot kar sakenge." Kanoria ne yeh bhi kaha, "Nayi Obama sarkar bhavishya ki soch rakhte hue vyavaharik dhang se outsourcing jaise vishayon par aage badegi. Aakhirkar agar American companies saste mein kaam karayengi to wo apne yahan adhik nivesh kar payengi." Samachar agency PTI ne Bharti Airtel group ke malik Sunil Mittal ke hawale se kaha hai, "Humne pehle bhi elections ke dauran is tarah ki baatein sun chuke hain. Bill Clinton ne bhi election prachar ke dauran iske khilaf bahut baatein ki thi lekin unke rashtrapati banne ke baad humne Bharat ke saath American companies ke vyapar par koi prabhav nahi dekha."
summary: Barack Obama ne pichle election ke dauran outsourcing ke khilaf bhashan diye the, lekin CII ke Chandrjeet Banerjee ka maana hai "rajneetik atishyokti alankar". R V Kanoria ne bhi Bharatiya mool ke matdataon ne Obama ki jeet mein badi bhumika ada ki hai aur Sunil Mittal ne kaha "humne pehle bhi elections ke dauran is tarah ki baatein sun chuke hain".

source: Naye direction instructions ke mutabik ek healthy vyakti ka weight uske Body Mass Index ke hisaab se hona chahiye National Institute of Health and Care Excellence ke mutabik inhe aur anya sajati logon ko apne weight ko lekar extra caution baratni chahiye kyunki ve diabetes jaisi bimaariyon se grast hain. World Health Organization ki recommendations ke anuroop BMI ke is strict criteria ne Britain ko Bharat ke saath laakar khada kar diya hai. Naye BMI ke anusar paanch foot 11 inch lamba ek Asian purush ka weight 75 kilogram se kam, jabki paanch foot teen inch lambi ek mahila ka weight 59 kilogram se kam hona chahiye. Body Mass Index naye direction instructions ke mutabik ek healthy vyakti ka weight uske Body Mass Index ke hisaab se hona chahiye. BMI ek tareeka hai jisse yeh dekha ja sakta hai ki aapka weight aapki lambai ke mutabik hai ya nahi. Apne bhar (kilogram mein) ko apni lambai (meter mein) se divide karke koi bhi vyakti apna BMI score nikal sakta hai. Experts ke mutabik Britain ke sabhi adults ko healthy rehne ke liye 25 se kam BMI achieve karna hoga. Lekin, National Institute of Health and Care Excellence ke mutabik kuch races ke liye BMI ka itna score bhi sufficient nahi hai. Naye direction instructions kehte hain ki races ka BMI 23 se kam hona chahiye. Sharir mein maujood extra fat se type-2 diabetes 50 percent, heart disease aur cancer hone ka khatra paanch percent tak badh jata hai kaale, Asian aur dusre minority ethnic groups mein zyada health problems ke bawajood badhti motape ki dar white population ke samaan hi hai. Royal College of UK ke doctor Rachel Prick ke mutabik ye direction-instructions logon ke liye bahut helpful honge, khaaskar unke liye jo apne health ke prati bahut sensitive hote hain.
